integrity: The primary MSC 03D28 and first public date were verified from the arXiv record. Theorem 1.2 and Proposition A.2 were checked in the full primary HTML. The proof applies Proposition A.2 separately to each nonempty basic slice supplied by Theorem 1.2, then uses the GL1 identity and the elementary countability of the reals computable from a fixed oracle.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is a structural corollary of the local Join Property and the independent fibre theorem in the same recent source. It applies to the constructed special generalized-low class, not to arbitrary special Pi01 classes, and it does not classify the order structure of degrees within a fibre or give a uniform selector.
title: Every jump-inversion fibre is locally countably degree-rich
